heroHeadline: Day 4,834: BTS Wraps North American Leg as Highest-Grossing Vocal-Group Tour Ever
heroSubtitle: September 7, 2026 is Day 4,834 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. BTS closed the ARIRANG World Tour's North American leg with a SoFi Stadium finale in Los Angeles on Sept 6, a day after Billboard Boxscore confirmed ARIRANG as the highest-grossing tour ever by a vocal group — $433.2 million grossed and 2.3 million tickets sold across 38 shows through Aug 11, surpassing BTS's own 'Love Yourself' tour and BLACKPINK's 'Born Pink' as the top Asian-artist tour. The North American leg's 31 shows across 12 regions since April drew an estimated 1.7 million fans with every date sold out; the tour now heads to Latin America, opening in Bogotá, Colombia on Oct 2.
